storage.notes: Built-in 32 GB eMMC (approx. 25 GB usable) plus microSD/SDHC/SDXC up to 256 GB; edge storage with re-transmission on network recovery; NAS (NFS, SMB/CIFS).

power.method: 12 VDC (reverse-polarity protected); solar kit: 45 W photovoltaic panel + 10 Ah lithium (ternary) battery

features: Solar-powered ultra-low-power 4G bullet camera kit (45 W PV panel + 10 Ah lithium battery)
PIR passive-infrared human detection up to 10 m, triggers fast wake-from-sleep, snapshot and recording upload
ultra-low power: typical 1.85 W (4G active), 40 mW standby, 4.8 W max
runtime: 3 days in low-power real-time mode, 25 days in sleep/wake mode (per datasheet duty cycle)
IR supplement up to 30 m (850 nm), anti-overexposure supplement light
remote low-power-mode configuration and multiple wake methods via platform
built-in microphone and speaker (two-way audio), audio noise filtering
release_notes: Hikvision DS-2XS2T26XM-IGLE/CH10S45 is a 2 MP solar-powered, 4G ultra-low-power bullet camera kit for off-grid remote sites (power line, river, pipeline, forest monitoring). It ships with a 45 W solar panel and 10 Ah lithium battery, uses PIR-triggered wake-from-sleep, and consumes under 1.1 W at full resolution excluding 4G transmission.

frigate.notes: Battery/solar low-power 4G camera; sleep/wake duty cycle means the RTSP stream is only reachable while the camera is awake.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform RTSP; low-power sleep/wake behaviour limits continuous local streaming.
